description: A subtle, linear ridge trending NE–SW with an average width of ~3–5 m and an apparent length of ~160 m. It stands out as a low‐relief, rectilinear embankment cutting across minor drainage divides in the hillshade and is paralleled by vegetation stress in the NIR band, suggesting a buried canal or water‐retaining channel.

A roughly rectangular, raised‐platform feature measuring approximately 60 m by 45 m. It appears as a very subtle plateau in the DTM hillshade, with slightly enhanced moisture (darker tones) in the NIR overlay, consistent with anthropogenic dark‐earth soils used for intensive cultivation or habitation.

A cluster of small, circular depressions (~8–12 m diameter) aligned parallel to the NE–SW ridge (anomaly_1). These are visible as negative curvatures in the DTM and correspond to slight vegetation anomalies in NIR, suggesting platform‐house remains associated with the canal system.
